sentences.text: Shri Abhinav Dubey -learned counsel for the appellan  Shri Nitin Gupta - learned Government Advocate for t State.
Heard on I.A.No. 25933/2025 , which is an application for temporary suspension of sentence and grant of temporary bail on behalf of the appellant.

This appeal is filed by the appellant being aggrieved of judgment dated 08.11.2023 passed in Special Case No. 45/2022 by the learned Special Judge (POCSO Act, 2012), District Narmadapuram whereby the appellant has been convicted under Section 363 of IPC and sentenced to R.I. for 3 years with fine of Rs.1,000/-, Section 366 of IPC and sentenced to R.I. for 5 years with fine of Rs.1,000/-,
Section 376(3) of IPC and sentenced to R.I. for 20 years with fine of Rs.2,000/-, Section 5(L)/6 of the P.O.C.S.O. Act and sentenced to R.I. for 20 years with fine of Rs.2,000/- along with default stipulations.
Though the appellant has also been convicted under Section 3/ 4 of the POCSO Act, but has not been separately sentenced.
Learned counsel for the appellant submits that marriage of brother of the appellant is scheduled on 12.11.2025.
Marriage Invitation Card is annexed with the application.
It is, therefore, prayed that appellant be granted temporary suspension of sentence for the aforesaid purpose.
Shri Nitin Gupta, learned Government Advocate has submitted a report dated 05.11.2025 verifying that marriage of appellant's brother is scheduled on 12.11.2025.
The aforesaid report is taken on record.

After hearing learned counsel for the parties and considering the facts and circumstances of the case, this Court is of the considered opinion that it is a fit case to temporarily suspend the jail Ashish @ K D Maseeh vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 6 November, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/159773021/
1 sentence of appellant - Ashish @ K D Maseeh and release him on temporary bail.
It is directed that on depositing of fine amount, if not already deposited and on furnishing personal bond to the tune of Rs.50,000/- (Rupees Fifty Thousand only) with two sureties in the like amount to the satisfaction of the Trial Court the appellant be released on 11.11.2025 at 11.00 am.

sentences.text: The appellant shall surrender before the Trial Court by 11:00 a.m. on 13.11.2025 positively so that he may be lodged back to the prison on the same day for undergoing the remaining part of his jail sentence.
If the appellant fails to surrender as directed above the Trial Court would be at liberty to initiate appropriate steps for taking him into custody.
List for final hearing in due course.
